title: Groups and arrays
summary: Find totals of equal groups of 2 and 5, share equally, and make groups of 2.
subject: maths

difficultyRamp.within: Q1 counts 2 groups of 2 in twos (4). Child sees equal groups, not one pile. Q2 counts 3 groups of 2 (6). Q3 makes 3 groups of 2. Q4 spots equal groups against unequal. Q5 counts 4 groups of 2, not 8 objects. Q6 shares 6 equally between 2, one at a time. Q7 matches the words 2 groups of 5 to a picture. Q8 counts 2 groups of 5 in fives (10). Q9 taps two pictures with equal groups. Q10 groups 10 objects into twos.
difficultyRamp.versus: Easy uses small equal groups of 2 and 5, totals to 10, sharing into 2, and grouping 10 into twos. Medium uses totals to 30, groups of 10, and grouping versus sharing stories. Hard reads an array both ways, finds a missing number of groups, and spots unequal groups. Hard is a new kind of thinking, not just bigger numbers.

questions.hint: The groups are equal. Jump 2, then 2 more.
